extension.summary: Spotify Connect for Kodi via Spotify Soloist
Spotify Connect für Kodi über Spotify Soloist
extension.description: Makes Kodi a Spotify Connect device using Spotify's official Soloist client. Soloist runs in an isolated Docker container; its audio and now-playing info appear in Kodi. Requires a Soloist API key from a Spotify Premium account.

Macht Kodi zu einem Spotify-Connect-Gerät über Spotifys offiziellen Soloist-Client. Soloist läuft isoliert in einem Docker-Container; Ton und Titelinfos erscheinen in Kodi. Benötigt einen Soloist-API-Key von einem Spotify-Premium-Account.
extension.disclaimer: Spotify Soloist is proprietary software by Spotify and is downloaded from Spotify at runtime; it is not part of this add-on.
